description: This file contains Python classes and functions for managing Android build information and database operations related to build files, including parsing build properties from zip files and storing build metadata in an SQLite database.

classes.name: BuildInfo
classes.description: A class representing Android build metadata, capable of parsing build properties from zip files and converting data for database storage.

classes.name: TargetLib
classes.description: A class managing build records in an SQLite database, including adding new builds and retrieving build information.

methods.name: analyse_buildprop
methods.description: Parses build properties from a zip file to extract build ID, version, flavor, and partitions.

methods.name: to_sql_form_dict
methods.description: Converts BuildInfo instance to a dictionary suitable for SQL insertion, with partitions joined into a string.

methods.name: to_dict
methods.description: Returns the BuildInfo data as a standard dictionary.

methods.name: TargetLib.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the TargetLib instance, creating the database table if it does not exist.

methods.name: TargetLib.new_build
methods.description: Creates a new build record from a filename and path, parsing build properties and storing metadata in the database.

methods.name: TargetLib.new_build_from_dir
methods.description: Scans the working directory for zip files and adds them as new builds to the database.

methods.name: TargetLib.sql_to_buildinfo
methods.description: Converts a database row into a BuildInfo object.

methods.name: TargetLib.get_builds
methods.description: Retrieves all build records from the database.

methods.name: TargetLib.get_build_by_path
methods.description: Retrieves a specific build record by its file path.
